نستميت (form X)
# نَسْتَمِيتُ (nastamītu) /nas.ta.miː.tu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمَاتَ (istamāta)
# نَسْتَمِيتَ (nastamīta) /nas.ta.miː.ta/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَمَاتَ (istamāta)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
